title: Illagers Wear Armor
body:
Are you tired of Illagers being weak, not wearing anything to protect them?

Do you think raids should be harder?

This mod is for you, with config options to disable certain Illagers spawning with armor naturally, or stop all of them from spawning with armor altogether!

Illagers from other mods should be able to render armor if they inherit the IllagerModel class in their code.

To make illagers spawn with custom equipment, simply override these files in a custom datapack:

https://github.com/seymourimadeit/illagersweararmor/tree/main/src/main/resources/data/illagersweararmor/loot_table/entities
